rule: IE masks a line only if (a) it differs between the twins of its base case (pair-level; record line class 'digest'/'state' that remains after pair_mask), or (b) it is AUTHORITATIVE policy state on this allowlist (record line class 'resolved'), which is masked even when identical. Background (scheduled-job) records always render in IE as one identical terse entry per run (run times are aligned across twins); their content is authoritative system state.

authoritative_fields.field: digest the alias resolved to at deploy time
dataset an alias resolved to at consumption time

system state changes: alias moves, registry/mirror syncs, reservation activation/expiry/release/extension, quota commits, consent versions and effective times, review closes, safeguard changes, deploy-queue execution

non_authoritative_notes: F3 f3_tags output ([tags] <ds>: ...) shows DISPLAY tags, which are not authoritative (schema, RP-3): class state, pair-masked only when it differs between twins (v8.1, A3 R7.3).
F1 f1_build statistics (dependency count, build steps, cached steps, duration) are drawn from pair-level values and identical across twins (v8.1, A3 R7.1).
